svg.title: IMG-04-01 Vehicle overview, top view and left side, with callouts
svg.desc: From the drafter CAD sheet IMG-04-01 (2026-11-15), views cropped, no title block. Top-view panel buttons rearranged and recoloured to the owner-corrected layout of IMG-04-02. Front = control-panel end; scanner position confirmed by the owner 2026-11-15. Electrical-box and line-sensor callouts placed from the CAD geometry.
svg.text: Battery, behind the battery access cover
Electrical box, under the front cover
Magnetic line sensor, under the vehicle
Not visible: horn and safety encoders (inside the vehicle), pendant.
Dimensions in mm. Body 1400 × 574 × 367; overall 1604 × 596 × 591 with the towing hitch.
